Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Southold for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, at least 4 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (the Holiday Tree Lighting at Orient Beach State Park) through December 19 (Holiday Craft Decorating in Greenport), with the Southampton Parade of Lights on November 28, the Greenport Parade of Lights on December 5 and Santa arriving by train on December 12. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Southold

  • 8 Christmas events for kids on the East End
  • Free events (at least 4): Orient tree lighting, SantaFest in East Hampton, the Greenport Parade of Lights and the Southampton Parade of Lights
  • Meet Santa: Santa arrives on the Greenport Scoot (December 12), SantaFest (December 5), Orient lighting (December 4)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Southampton (November 28), Greenport (December 5), East Hampton and Orient
  • Season: November 28 to December 19
